summary: Starwood Property Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $500 million private offering of 5.875% unsecured senior notes due 2029. The notes priced at 100% of principal, with settlement expected July 10, 2026. Net proceeds will be allocated to eligible green/social projects or used to redeem up to $500 million of 4.375% Senior Notes due 2027 or for general corporate purposes. The offering is exempt from registration under Rule 144A/Regulation S. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no deal terms such as price per share or premium involved.
